judgment_policy: Human/model semantic judgments derived from the authoritative corpus. User source authority, assistant-authored authority provenance, and referent/context grounding are distinct. Authority sources may supply adopted/retained assistant propositions; grounding sources may only identify referents in user-owned propositions and may not add semantic detail. Omit transient execution chatter, unsupported implications, and numbered progress framing.
